sentences.text: Por la noche, la abuela se sentó con los niños.
sentences.english: In the evening, their grandmother sat down with the children.
"Tell us a story, Grandma," said Marta.

sentences.text: —Voy a contarles cómo era mi vida cuando tenía su edad —dijo la abuela.
sentences.english: "I'm going to tell you what my life was like when I was your age," said Grandma.

sentences.text: —Cuando yo era niña, vivía en esta misma casa.
sentences.english: "When I was a girl, I lived in this very house.

sentences.text: Mi padre trabajaba en el campo y mi madre cocinaba.
sentences.english: My father worked in the fields and my mother cooked.

sentences.text: Todos los días yo iba a la escuela a pie.
sentences.english: Every day I went to school on foot.

sentences.text: La escuela quedaba lejos y tenía que caminar mucho.
sentences.english: The school was far away and I had to walk a lot.

sentences.text: Por la tarde ayudaba a mi madre a hacer tortillas.
sentences.english: In the afternoon I helped my mother make tortillas.

sentences.text: Mi hermano y yo jugábamos en el río.
sentences.english: My brother and I played in the river."
"And didn't you have toys?" asked Luis.

sentences.text: —Teníamos una pelota vieja y mucha imaginación —dijo la abuela, y se rió.
sentences.english: "We had an old ball and a lot of imagination," said Grandma, and she laughed.

sentences.text: —Mañana les voy a enseñar a hacer tortillas —dijo la abuela.
sentences.english: "Tomorrow I am going to teach you how to make tortillas," said Grandma.

sentences.text: Los niños se fueron a dormir muy contentos.
sentences.english: The children went to bed very happy.
